description: This file defines constants, enums, structures, and classes for a Motion Detection module, including an interface class 'MotionDetectionImpl' with virtual methods for platform-specific implementations, and a wrapper class 'MotionDetection' to access these functionalities. It also includes associated callback types and external function pointers.

classes.name: MotionDetectionImpl
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for motion detection hardware platform implementations, including methods for initialization, event registration, sensor management, and configuration.

classes.name: MotionDetection
classes.description: A wrapper class providing static methods to access motion detection functionalities by delegating to an implementation of 'MotionDetectionImpl'.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the static implementation instance used by the 'MotionDetection' wrapper.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_Platform_Init
methods.description: Initializes the motion detection platform via the implementation.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_Platform_Term
methods.description: Terminates the motion detection platform via the implementation.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_RegisterEventCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked on motion events.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_GetMotionDetectors
methods.description: Retrieves current sensor settings for motion detectors.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_ArmMotionDetector
methods.description: Arms a specific motion detector with a given sensitivity mode and index.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_DisarmMotionDetector
methods.description: Disarms a specific motion detector identified by index.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_IsMotionDetectorArmed
methods.description: Checks if a specific motion detector is armed.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_SetNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Sets the no-motion period for a specified detector.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_GetNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current no-motion period setting.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_SetSensitivity
methods.description: Sets the sensitivity for a specified detector.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_GetSensitivity
methods.description: Retrieves the current sensitivity setting and mode for a detector.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_SetActivePeriod
methods.description: Sets the active detection period for a detector.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_GetActivePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the active detection period setting.
